messages:
emily_s: Hey team — need quick alignment. Prospect (mid-market FinTech) requested an on-prem / VPC POC quote. Requirements: private VPC deployment, 6-week POC, 1 inference GPU node, KV cache, KMS integration, and enterprise support. They asked if we can waive platform license during the POC.
raj_sol: Clarifying: GPU node is inference-only, right? If so we can use Dedicated inference SKU. If they want fine-tuning that's a different SKU and cost.
emily_s: Correct — inference-only. They explicitly called out KMS for key management and want a short-term support SLA during the POC.
raj_sol: KMS integration carries a one-time integration surcharge. Platform-fee waivers for POCs are handled case-by-case; needs Deal Desk + Finance signoff.
hana_fin: @emily_s what's the anticipated post-POC commitment? We usually only waive platform fees if there's a credible conversion (e.g., >=12mo reserved or an ARR threshold).
emily_s: They signaled intent for a 12-month reserved commit but want optionality. Proposal idea: waive platform fee for the POC period but make it convertible to credit upon a qualifying commitment within 30 days post-POC. If they don't convert, credits expire / we invoice standard fees. Thoughts?
kevin_legal: Retroactive billing is messy. Prefer a convertible credit that is explicitly documented in the SOW: "POC Platform Fees will be applied as a credit to the first invoice(s) upon execution of a Reserved Capacity Agreement within 30 days; otherwise the credit expires." Legal happy with that approach if SOW language is explicit.
deal-desk-bot: Heads-up: discount or waiver >15% triggers Deal Desk review. Please attach draft rate card and SOW.
emily_s: Draft pricing (POC):```
- Dedicated inference node (1x): $12,000 / month
- On-prem Platform license (standard): $6,000 / month
- POC support reduced rate (3 months): $2,000 / month
- KMS integration (one-time): $8,000
- Proposed: Platform license waived for POC (conditional)
- Conversion incentive: 20% off platform/license for first 6 months after committed conversion
```
raj_sol: Looks reasonable. Suggest instead of retrobilling, make the POC platform fee a convertible credit capped to N months to simplify accounting.
hana_fin: Finance will accept a credit approach but requires a minimum conversion floor: either 12 months reserved or >= $150k ARR equivalent. Without that floor we risk margin leakage.
emily_s: Customer's estimated ARR if converted is ~$180k — I'll include that in the forecast.
kevin_legal: Add contract clause: "If Customer executes a Reserved Capacity Agreement within 30 days of POC completion, Vendor will apply POC Platform Fees as a credit against the first invoice(s), up to the credited amount. If no Agreement is executed within 30 days, credits expire and standard fees are due." Legal to review final SOW.
revenue_ops: FYI — we need this in the revenue forecast and to tag the opportunity for ACV tracking.
deal-desk-bot: Action created: DD-2026-114. Please attach final SOW, forecast, and proposed rate card.
emily_s: Two final asks for Deal Desk: 1) Approve conversion credit = 20% off capped at 6 months of platform fees. 2) Approve POC support discount: $0 for month 1, $2k for months 2-3.
raj_sol: Confirmed technical OK. On the billing side, cap credit to 6 months is easier. For KMS work we will include an SOW appendix for integration scope.
hana_fin: Finance approves conditional credit with floor of $150k ARR and 12-month minimum reserved commitment. Credit cap at 6 months of platform fees approved. POC support discount approved as proposed.
kevin_legal: Legal approves clause conceptually; please route final SOW to legal for redline before sending to customer. Include explicit clawback language if needed.
emily_s: I'll update SOW and SOW appendix (KMS tasks + acceptance criteria) and upload for Deal Desk review. Thanks all.
deal-desk-bot: Reminder: discount >15% recorded in DD system and requires sign-off from Sales Leadership if outside approved band.
emily_s: Noted. I'll attach supporting forecast and ask Sales Lead for sign-off after Deal Desk review.
revenue_ops: Adding opportunity tag and expected conversion probability 60% per initial tech fit.
emily_s: Uploading SOW now. Expect DD next steps in thread. Thanks team!
